text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One morning on a day off, I walk by the
dance
studio and see Mejiro Bright
inside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, fooour—hup, hup. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. You're up early this morning too,
I see. I
wished to see if I could memorize
the
choreography for a new dance
routine today.
choice_data_list: Self-training even on your day off? Impressive!
Self-training even on your day off? That's really impressive!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm just getting ready with a warm-up
right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No, not so. I'm just slower than the
others. It
takes me more time to
remember my
choreography.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I want to give the audience a
proper
performance during my winning
concerts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: After all, I am a member of the celebrated Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, then. Here's to a wonderful day for
us both.
Farewell for now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just after the sun sets, I remember a few
minor
things I need to take care of at my
office. On my
way back, I pass by the
dance studio again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, fooour—hup, hup. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You're the same trainer who passed
by
before, no? Have you been well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Cooling down? Goodness, is it already
this late?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Whoopsie. Looks like I got carried away
doing my
warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. I wanted to be thoroughly
prepared,
since I was going to learn new
choreography.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But now I don't have enough time to do
any
actual dancing anymore. What
should I do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see. That's a wonderful idea. Well then,
I'll do
just that and focus on the parts I
find most
difficult.
choice_data_list: How about working thoroughly on the areas you're concerned about?
Why not try getting a rough grasp of the whole thing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Mejiro Bright finally begins
her
rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's a fine suggestion. Acquainting
oneself with
the choreography as a
whole is never a bad idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it a try now. Thank you so much
for your
thoughtful advice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Mejiro Bright finally begins
her
rehearsal.
